First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 18–19 mph on average: brisk — you’ll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Ten Speed Spokes Saturday Social, Half Island group ride

Ten Speed Spokes Saturday Social, Half Island is a road group ride in Newport, RI. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Empire Coffee & Tea.

A mostly social road ride with a couple of spirited sections that regroups at set points. It averages 18 to 19 mph over about 32 miles and passes Empire Coffee again, so you can cut it to 20 miles.
